hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A pair of adjacent set bits occurs wherever bit i and bit i + 1 are simultaneously one.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Bitwise and of n and n shifted right by one isolates all adjacent set bit positions.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Check whether this isolated mask contains exactly one set bit.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def exactlyOneConsecutiveSetBitsPair(n: int) -> bool:
    pair_mask = n & (n >> 1)
    return pair_mask > 0 and (pair_mask & (pair_mask - 1)) == 0
```

complexity.notes: Bitwise masking and power of two popcount check executes in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping over all bit positions is unnecessary when bitwise operators apply.
